parameters.query:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        XDMI.XNUM_0               AS numero_demande,
        XDMI.XDAT_0               AS date_demande,
        XDMI.XCODD_0              AS code_salarie_demande,
        XDMI.XNDEM_0              AS nom_demandeur,
        ZPOSTEACTUEL.YTIT_0       AS poste_demandeur,
        ZSERVICESACTUEL.YTIT_0    AS service_demandeur,
        ZPOSTEPROPOSE.YTIT_0      AS poste_actuelle,
        ZSERVICESPROPOSE.YTIT_0   AS service_actuelle,
        XDMI.CREDATTIM_0          AS date_creation,
        XDMI.YDATCON_0            AS date_controle,
        XDMI.CREUSR_0             AS utilisateur_createur,

        P.VALEUR_0                AS delai_total_jours,

        -- Salarié (via YSALAUS, sinon CREUSR_0 = XSAL_0)
        x.XSAL_0                  AS code_salarie,
        x.XNAMSAL_0               AS nom_salarie,
        x.XPRENOM_0               AS prenom_salarie,
        x.XEMAIL_0                AS email_salarie,
        x.YTELE_0                 AS num_telephone_salarie,
        x.YSUP_0                  AS code_superieur,

        -- Supérieur
        xx.XSAL_0                 AS code_sup,
        xx.XNAMSAL_0              AS nom_superieur,
        xx.XPRENOM_0              AS prenom_superieur,
        xx.XEMAIL_0               AS email_superieur,
        xx.YTELE_0                AS num_telephone_sup,

        -- DGA
        dga.XSAL_0                AS code_dga,
        dga.XNAMSAL_0             AS nom_dga,
        dga.XPRENOM_0             AS prenom_dga,
        dga.XEMAIL_0              AS email_dga,
        dga.YTELE_0               AS telephone_dga,

        -- Calculs de délai
        DATEADD(DAY, CAST(P.VALEUR_0 AS INT), XDMI.CREDATTIM_0)                           AS date_limite,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, XDMI.CREDATTIM_0, GETDATE())                                         AS jours_depuis_creation,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), DATEADD(DAY, CAST(P.VALEUR_0 AS INT), XDMI.CREDATTIM_0)) AS jours_restants,
        CAST(P.VALEUR_0 AS INT)                                                         AS delai_int

    FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XDMI

    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE ZPOSTEACTUEL
        ON XDMI.YPOSTE_0 = ZPOSTEACTUEL.YNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZSERVICES ZSERVICESACTUEL
        ON ZPOSTEACTUEL.YSRV_0 = ZSERVICESACTUEL.YNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE ZPOSTEPROPOSE
        ON XDMI.YPSTPROP_0 = ZPOSTEPROPOSE.YNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZSERVICES ZSERVICESPROPOSE
        ON XDMI.XNSRV_0 = ZSERVICESPROPOSE.YNUM_0

    -- 1) Essai via YSALAUS (1 ligne max)
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 XSAL_0
        FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.YSALAUS
        WHERE USER_0 = XDMI.CREUSR_0
    ) s

    -- 2) Sinon, CREUSR_0 est directement un XSAL_0
    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL x
        ON x.XSAL_0 = COALESCE(s.XSAL_0, XDMI.CREUSR_0)

    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL xx
        ON xx.XSAL_0 = x.YSUP_0

    -- Délai : OUTER APPLY pour ne pas supprimer les lignes si le paramètre n'existe pas
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 VALEUR_0
        FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.ADOVAL
        WHERE PARAM_0 = 'YDELPJDMI'   -- à remplacer par le bon paramètre
    ) P

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 XSAL_0, XNAMSAL_0, XPRENOM_0, XEMAIL_0, YTELE_0
        FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL WHERE XSAL_0 = 'S0949'
    ) dga

    WHERE
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.AOBJTXT aobj
            WHERE aobj.IDENT1_0 = XDMI.XNUM_0
              AND aobj.ABREV_0 = 'XDMI'
        )
        AND CAST(XDMI.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE) >= '2026-01-01'
)

SELECT *,
    CASE
        WHEN jours_restants <= 3                                       THEN 'SUPERIEUR'
        WHEN jours_restants <= 4                                       THEN 'SALARIE'
        WHEN jours_restants > 4 AND jours_restants <= (delai_int / 2) THEN 'DGA'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS niveau_escalade
FROM base
ORDER BY jours_restants ASC;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        XDMI.XNUM_0               AS numero_demande,
        XDMI.XDAT_0               AS date_demande,
        XDMI.XCODD_0              AS code_salarie_demande,
        XDMI.XNDEM_0              AS nom_demandeur,
        ZPOSTEACTUEL.YTIT_0       AS poste_demandeur,
        ZSERVICESACTUEL.YTIT_0    AS service_demandeur,
        ZPOSTEPROPOSE.YTIT_0      AS poste_actuelle,
        ZSERVICESPROPOSE.YTIT_0   AS service_actuelle,
        XDMI.CREDATTIM_0          AS date_creation,
        XDMI.YDATCON_0            AS date_controle,
        XDMI.CREUSR_0             AS utilisateur_createur,

        30               AS delai_total_jours,

        -- Salarié (via YSALAUS, sinon CREUSR_0 = XSAL_0)
        x.XSAL_0                  AS code_salarie,
        x.XNAMSAL_0               AS nom_salarie,
        x.XPRENOM_0               AS prenom_salarie,
        x.XEMAIL_0                AS email_salarie,
        x.YTELE_0                 AS num_telephone_salarie,
        x.YSUP_0                  AS code_superieur,

        -- Supérieur
        xx.XSAL_0                 AS code_sup,
        xx.XNAMSAL_0              AS nom_superieur,
        xx.XPRENOM_0              AS prenom_superieur,
        xx.XEMAIL_0               AS email_superieur,
        xx.YTELE_0                AS num_telephone_sup,

        -- DGA
        dga.XSAL_0                AS code_dga,
        dga.XNAMSAL_0             AS nom_dga,
        dga.XPRENOM_0             AS prenom_dga,
        dga.XEMAIL_0              AS email_dga,
        dga.YTELE_0               AS telephone_dga,

        -- Jours restants = (date création + délai) - aujourd'hui
        DATEADD(DAY, 30, CAST(XDMI.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE))                                         AS date_limite,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(XDMI.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))                           AS jours_depuis_creation,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), DATEADD(DAY, 30, CAST(XDMI.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE))) AS jours_restants,
       30                                                                                       AS delai_int

    FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XDMI

    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE ZPOSTEACTUEL
        ON XDMI.YPOSTE_0 = ZPOSTEACTUEL.YNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZSERVICES ZSERVICESACTUEL
        ON ZPOSTEACTUEL.YSRV_0 = ZSERVICESACTUEL.YNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE ZPOSTEPROPOSE
        ON XDMI.YPSTPROP_0 = ZPOSTEPROPOSE.YNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZSERVICES ZSERVICESPROPOSE
        ON XDMI.XNSRV_0 = ZSERVICESPROPOSE.YNUM_0

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 XSAL_0
        FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.YSALAUS
        WHERE USER_0 = XDMI.CREUSR_0
    ) s

    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL x
        ON x.XSAL_0 = COALESCE(s.XSAL_0, XDMI.CREUSR_0)

    LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL xx
        ON xx.XSAL_0 = x.YSUP_0

    -- Délai : paramètre ADOVAL s'il existe, sinon 15 jours par défaut (à adapter)
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT COALESCE(
            (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(VALEUR_0 AS INT)
             FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.ADOVAL
             WHERE PARAM_0 = '30'),
            15
        ) AS VALEUR_0
    ) P

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 XSAL_0, XNAMSAL_0, XPRENOM_0, XEMAIL_0, YTELE_0
        FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL WHERE XSAL_0 = 'S0949'
    ) dga

    WHERE
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.AOBJTXT aobj
            WHERE aobj.IDENT1_0 = XDMI.XNUM_0
              AND aobj.ABREV_0 = 'XDMI'
        )
        AND CAST(XDMI.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE) >= '2026-01-01'
)

SELECT *,
    CASE
        WHEN jours_restants <= 3                                       THEN 'SUPERIEUR'
        WHEN jours_restants = 4                                       THEN 'SALARIE'
        WHEN jours_restants > 4 AND jours_restants <= (delai_int / 2) THEN 'DGA'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS niveau_escalade
FROM base
ORDER BY jours_restants ASC;
